description:
Defense-in-depth gap: extension-server crates that walk attacker-controlled Filter<T> trees do so without an internal recursion cap. Worst-case depth is bounded by serde_json's default 128-level deserializer cap + jmap-server's documented ~32-level integrator contract (parse.rs:42-47), but a consumer who skips the contract on a small tokio worker stack can theoretically hit stack-overflow.

Per-walker site survey (2026-05-15):
- jmap-metadata-server: metadata.rs:656 walk_filter_for_unknown_keys (Value tree), metadata.rs:704 walk_filter_for_related_ids_constraint (typed Filter tree). Currently unguarded.
- jmap-mail-server: no analog filter-walker pattern in src/ (the RFC 8621 spec has no analog of draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-01 §3.4.1's cross-field constraint). So the gap is metadata-server-specific TODAY, but every future extension that needs cross-field filter validation will inherit the same shape.
- Other 6 extension-server siblings: unaudited for cross-field filter validation.

Right architectural fix: add a foundation-level helper to jmap-server, e.g.

  /// Walk a typed Filter<T> tree depth-first, calling  on
  /// every leaf condition. Caps recursion depth at MAX_FILTER_DEPTH
  /// (32) to match parse::MAX_NESTING_DEPTH; returns
  /// unsupportedFilter on overflow.
  pub fn walk_filter<T, F>(
      filter: &Filter<T>,
      predicate: F,
  ) -> Result<(), JmapError>
  where F: FnMut(&T) -> Result<(), JmapError>;

Plus a Value-tree analog for the raw JSON walker pattern.

Propagation plan:
1. Implement helpers + tests in jmap-server.
2. Re-implement validate_metadata_filter / walk_filter_for_unknown_keys / walk_filter_for_related_ids_constraint on top of the helpers; assert overflow returns unsupportedFilter.
3. Audit chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/filenode/sharing for similar walkers and migrate them.
4. Update each extension's filter rustdoc to cite the helper-provided cap.

Discovered while triaging bd:JMAP-826m.52 (which carries a documentation-only fix in the metadata-server crate as a stopgap). The proper fix lives at the foundation layer.
title: Foundation-level helper: depth-capped filter walker in jmap-server (then propagate to all extension-server filter walkers)
